context:
Goal: mailaudit records state only what is true now (your 191 b, retire the GitHub-token records).
Problem (rule): this record says the ledger push shares GitHub's write budget. After 191 b the app makes no GitHub writes, so the record is now false. Retiring it is a new act that 191 b did not name.
Based on (read): lane mailaudit-token-records-retire, 07:09 CST, PR #196.
Departs from: main — deletes the open thread the-write-budget-is-shared and its index line in CLAUDE.md.

Meanwhile: draft PR mailaudit #196 goes ahead without it, and batch runner 9 batches it.
home: mailaudit open thread the-write-budget-is-shared; mailaudit CLAUDE.md index

options.how: A follow-up PR deletes the record and its index line in CLAUDE.md.
options.label: Retire it in a small follow-up to #196
options.lose: If GitHub writes come back, the risk must be written again.

options.how: The record gets a dormant mark.
options.label: Keep it, marked dormant until GitHub writes return
options.lose: A live record states something false today.

title: Retire mailaudit's open-thread record the-write-budget-is-shared?
why: Recommended: a. The app makes no GitHub writes now, so the record is false, and git keeps its text if the risk returns.
